title: The Log Nobody Could Search: Categories, Filter Rules, a Severity That Is Not in Order and a Log That Keeps the Last Thousand

questions.question: A category is off. A debug message from it has an argument that calls a function. What happens?
options: The function runs and the message is dropped
Neither: the message is not built, so the function does not run
questions.explanation: The arguments were worked out 1 time, for the plan only.

questions.question: Rules: *.debug=false and then station.link.debug=true. Is link debug on?
options: Yes: the last rule that matches wins
questions.explanation: The link gave 1 message and the plan 0.

questions.question: The same two rules in the other order. Is link debug on?
options: No: the general rule came last and took it back
questions.explanation: The other way round it was 0 and 0.

questions.question: What number is QtInfoMsg?
questions.explanation: Information is numbered above a fatal error.

questions.question: A filter says type >= QtWarningMsg. Which of debug, info, warning and critical does it keep?
options: Info, warning and critical: the information got in by its number
questions.explanation: The numbers gave 3 and the order of severity gave 2.

questions.question: A ring of 1000 receives 5000 messages. What does it hold?
options: The last 1000, oldest first, and has counted 4000 dropped
questions.explanation: The oldest that was left was number 4000.
